projects.name: Stockroom web shop
projects.description: The cart and formatting of the web shop (TypeScript).

issues.title: Stock report: show the location column wider
issues.description: Locations like D12 are cut off in some mail clients. Not urgent.

issues.title: Reserve kits in one go
issues.description: The workshop orders kits (hammer + screws). Reserving the parts one by one leaves half-reserved kits when one part runs out.

issues.title: Restock plan ignores reserved units
issues.description: Items with many reservations were not in the restock plan although almost nothing was available.

comments.author: marieke
comments.body: needs_reorder now looks at available units instead of the quantity.

issues.title: Reservations lose their timezone after saving
issues.description: After a restart the CLI crashes with `TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes` when it expires reservations. Probably the way timestamps are written to the JSON file. A regression test is on main.

comments.author: joost
comments.body: Happens every morning since we keep the CLI's data file between days.

issues.title: VAT is one cent off on some orders
issues.description: Ingrid found orders where our VAT is one cent lower than her calculation. Rounding?

comments.author: ingrid
comments.body: Example: a net line of EUR 2.50 at 21% must have EUR 0.53 VAT; we print EUR 0.52. The tax office rounds half a cent up.

issues.title: Low stock overview on the command line
issues.description: Joost wants a quick list of what is running low without the whole restock plan: every item whose available units are at or below its reorder level, with how many are missing.

issues.title: CSV export breaks in the spreadsheet for some items
issues.description:
When I open the export of `python3 -m stockroom.cli export` in the spreadsheet, a few rows have their columns shifted: the category column shows part of the name and the numbers end up in the wrong columns. It happens for the screws (SR-1012) and the book about small spaces (SR-1069). The other rows are fine.

Expected: every row has the same eight columns as the header, whatever the item is called.

comments.author: ingrid
comments.body: The name of SR-1012 is `Screws, wood, 4x40 mm (box of 200)`. Could the commas be the problem?

comments.author: marieke
comments.body: Probably. The export joins the fields with commas by hand. Please use proper CSV quoting (the csv module) and keep the header and the number format as they are; Ingrid's import depends on them.

comments.author: ingrid
comments.body: Yes please keep `12.50` style amounts with a dot.

issues.title: Import items from a CSV file
issues.description: New suppliers send their price lists as CSV. We want to import them: add new SKUs and update existing ones, and report bad lines instead of stopping.

issues.title: Move the discount rules to pricing
issues.description: Discount rules live in orders.py but are about prices. Move them to pricing.py so the web shop team finds them next to VAT.

issues.title: Count sheets per location as PDF
issues.description: For the yearly count, print a sheet per location with the expected quantities left blank.

issues.title: Free shipping threshold should use the discounted amount
issues.description: A customer with a discount code paid shipping although the cart showed more than EUR 50 before the discount. Decided: the threshold uses the amount after the discount.

comments.author: daan
comments.body: shippingCents now gets subtotal minus discount.

issues.title: Refund lines show the minus sign in the wrong place
issues.description: Negative amounts are shown as `€-5.00`; they must be `-€5.00`. Amounts below one euro lose their sign completely: -50 cents shows as `€0.50`.
